narrative.overview: A dark room where broadcast tape and a match database are reviewed on the same desk. The walls are stone, not glass: the ground is a warm near-black, panels sit on it as flat slabs with a single hairline, and light is spent only where a number or a face needs to be read. Nothing shimmers, because a review room does not shimmer — the drama belongs to the footage, and the surface's job is to disappear behind it. The system serves two readers at one scale: a fan scanning sixty-one players, and a coach opening one of them to read a season's shape. Colour is information or it is absent — signal red for location and loss, pitch green for wins, and each team's crest colour sampled from its own logo.
keyCharacteristics: Kiln ground, salt type, seam hairlines; depth is tonal, never shadowed.
One headline figure per card; everything else supports at 12px or smaller.
Charts always draw their 50th percentile and say which direction is better.
Mono is chrome — rail, tables, legends — never a card's voice.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is used on ≤2% of a screen: the active rail tab and a loss. Anywhere else it must name a failure.

rules.name: The Crest Is Data Rule
rules.body: A team's colour is sampled from its logo and clamped, never chosen. A team with no saturated hue gets the neutral hairline.

rules.name: The One Headline Rule
rules.body: A card carries exactly one figure at 22–24px. Everything else on it is 12px or smaller, and the second-largest mark is the name.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono never appears inside a player card. It belongs to the rail, tables, legends and machine values.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change column is tabular. A figure that shifts the layout beside it is a defect.

rules.name: The Overlap-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter is allowed only where a surface sits over imagery or scrolling content.

rules.name: The Seam-First Rule
rules.body: Separate two surfaces with a 1px seam or a tone change. Never a shadow.

dos: Do lead every card with one figure at 22–24px and keep the rest at 12px or smaller.
Do draw the 50th percentile on any percentile chart, and name which direction is better.
Do sample team colour from the crest and clamp it for the dark ground.
Do keep numerals tabular and aligned to their column.
Do test 390 and 1440 before calling a surface finished.
donts: Don't put JetBrains Mono inside a player card.
Don't leave a UA font on a control: inherit the UI face.
Don't blur a panel that sits on flat ground.
Don't fill a card or row with a team colour; the accent is a 2px edge or a tint.
Don't use signal red for anything that is not location or loss.
Don't invent a colour for a team whose crest has none.
